```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Setting Locale
To change the localization, you can use the `locale` argument in the `config()` function. 

```{r, results = 'hide'}
library(plotly.core)

x <- seq.Date(Sys.Date(), Sys.Date() + 360, by = "day")

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = x, y = rnorm(length(x)), mode = "lines") |>
  config(locale = "zh-CN")
```

### Reference

See `config()` for more information about config options or [click here](configuration-options.html). For more information regarding localization, [click here](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/tree/master/dist#to-include-localization).
